# How to submit your EDF to {bank}

**Note: the HDFC Bank format is unverified.** Korra does not yet have HDFC Bank's own EDF template, so this pack uses a generic layout. Check with your bank whether it accepts it or needs its own form.

Month: {month}. Due by: {dueDate} (30 days after month-end).

1. Log in to HDFC Bank's trade or forex portal, or contact your relationship manager.
2. Submit the EDF with copies of the invoices (see the supporting zip) within 30 days of month-end, by {dueDate}.
3. Keep the acknowledgement.
4. Upload the acknowledgement back to Korra and mark the pack as submitted.

Prepared by Korra. Not legal or tax advice. Verify before submission.
